comment: The tax class applied to shipping charges.
modal: Which product tax class shipping is taxed under. Pick the class whose rates should apply to the shipping amount (or a 'None' class to leave shipping untaxed).

comment: The tax class assigned to a new product when none is set.
modal: The default product tax class used for products that don't specify one, determining which tax rates apply to them.

comment: The tax class assigned to a customer group when none is set.
modal: The default customer tax class, used together with the product tax class to resolve the applicable tax rate.

comment: How tax is rounded — per unit, per row, or on the total.
modal: The rounding method for tax: **Unit Price** (round each item), **Row Total** (round each line), or **Total** (round the order total). Affects cent-level differences on multi-item orders.

comment: Which address tax is calculated from.
modal: Whether tax is based on the **Shipping Address**, the **Billing Address**, or the store's **Shipping Origin**.

comment: Whether tax is applied before or after discounts.
modal: Chooses whether customer tax is calculated on the price **Before Discount** or **After Discount** — this changes the taxable base when promotions apply.

comment: Whether tax uses the custom price or the original price.
modal: Applies tax on the **Custom price if available**, or always on the **Original price**, for items with a special/custom price.

comment: Default country used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
modal: The fallback destination country for tax estimation (e.g. catalog prices) until the customer provides an address.

comment: Default state/region used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
modal: The fallback destination state/region for tax estimation, paired with the Default Country.

comment: Default post code used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
modal: The fallback destination post code for tax estimation. Use `*` to match any post code within the default region.

comment: Whether catalog prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: How product prices appear in the catalog: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

comment: Whether shipping prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: How shipping amounts are displayed in the catalog/estimates: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

comment: Whether cart item prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: Price display for items in the shopping cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

comment: Whether the cart subtotal shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: Subtotal display in the cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

comment: Whether the cart shipping amount shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: Shipping-amount display in the cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

comment: Whether the cart also shows the order total without tax.
modal: When **Yes**, the cart additionally shows the grand total excluding tax alongside the taxed total.

comment: Whether the cart breaks tax down by rate instead of a single line.
modal: When **Yes**, the cart shows a full tax summary (each tax rate itemised) rather than one combined tax line.

comment: Whether a zero-value tax line is shown in the cart.
modal: When **Yes**, a tax line is shown even when the tax amount is zero; when **No**, it is hidden.

comment: Whether prices on orders, invoices and credit memos show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
modal: Price display on sales documents (orders, invoices, credit memos): **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.
basis: group:Orders, Invoices, Credit Memos Display Settings
